graphEvents.label: sk-doc validators on sk-code, sk-design and sk-prompt
sk-prompt playbook File-table path off by one
sk-design playbook has no operator scenarios

label: sk-prompt's playbook File table points one directory too high: clear-scoring/forty-of-fifty-threshold.md:82 lists ../../manual-testing-playbook.md, which resolves to sk-prompt/manual-testing-playbook.md and does not exist; the root page is sk-prompt/manual-testing-playbook/manual-testing-playbook.md. The v4.0.0.9 playbook validator reports BACKTICK_PATH_UNRESOLVED as a warning and exits 0, so the defect never blocks.

v4.0.0.16 note says /doctor:sk-code quality writes the quality config on --apply, but the command contract accepts only --dry-run for that target (argument-hint line 3, flag table section 4) and rejects a flag outside allowed_flags, so an operator following the note gets the unknown-flag failure.

sk-design's manual-testing-playbook has zero operator scenarios: the validator returns SKIP package=sk-design tier=FAIL_CLOSED scenarios=4 categories=3 operator=0 routing_gold_excluded=4, so a fail-closed package validates nothing on that hub and can drift without a gate.

quality-gate.cjs runs from the documented path, discovers .skilled/skills/sk-code/sk-code-quality/repository/quality.json, applies the review.todo-tracking override, and exits 4 UNVERIFIED under --no-run because required checks stay LISTED.
validate_catalog_package.py exits 2 for --package sk-design --package sk-prompt (not in feature-catalog discovery); only sk-code has a catalog package and passes with violations=0.
